brief.motion: Documentary science: slow camera drift, light that behaves like light (glow, bloom, streaks), particles with physical easing. Diagrams build exactly as the narrator names each part.
brief.story: A lecture deck becomes a short science explainer. Night-sky stage, a sun that recurs as a motif, one warm paper scene for the circuit diagram.

slides.title: How solar panels work
slides.notes: Sunlight carries energy in tiny packets called photons. This is how a solar panel turns them into electricity.
slides.storyboard: dark sky; a sun rises from below frame with a bloom. On 'photons' streaks of light rain diagonally onto a solar panel that tilts into view in 3D; on 'electricity' the panel's cells light up row by row and the title typesets over it.

slides.title: Inside a silicon cell
bullets: The cell's electric field pushes them one way
slides.notes: When a photon hits the silicon, it knocks an electron loose. The cell's built-in electric field pushes those electrons one way, and that flow is a current.
slides.storyboard: zoom into a silicon lattice of glowing atoms. A photon streak hits on 'photon'; an electron pops free on 'loose'. On 'electric field' chevrons sweep across; on 'current' many electrons stream right in a river of light with a label.

slides.title: From panel to power point
bullets: An inverter converts it to AC
slides.notes: Panels produce direct current. An inverter switches it to alternating current, the kind your home runs on.
slides.storyboard: warm paper scene, engineering-diagram style. Panel, inverter and house are drawn as line art; a straight DC line flows from the panel on 'direct current', becomes a sine wave through the inverter on 'alternating', and the house windows light up on 'home'.

slides.title: Output across a sunny day
slides.notes: Output follows the sun. It climbs through the morning, peaks around midday, and fades by evening.
slides.storyboard: the plain line chart is shown, then the stage turns to a dusk-to-day sky. The sun travels an arc while the real data curve draws beneath it in sync; area fills amber; 'peaks' pins 3.9 kW at 12pm; on 'fades' the sky dims and the lecture title card settles.
